title: Keep your desktop moving
summary: Fix visible video widgets and slideshows being paused by a macOS desktop helper, with safer backups, library recovery and clearer Shortcuts errors.
details: Keep uncovered videos, animated images and slideshows playing when macOS reports its full-display Dock helper above them. Real covering windows, hidden Spaces and energy-saving policies still pause playback.
Explain when a saved library cannot be opened and offer explicit recovery from a backup, preserving the damaged library before replacement.
Prepare backups off the main thread, stream media and reject unsupported archive sizes safely. Preserve existing backups and library data when an operation fails.
Report failed imports, saves and slideshow changes to Shortcuts instead of reporting success.
Find an optional Support Arras link in the free edition’s Preferences and Options menu. Buying the App Store edition supports development; all free features remain available.
